title: Bad usability of applets/panel configuration/widget explorer/activity switcher with "Focus follows mouse"
line: With focus follows mouse, the activity switcher, widget explorer, panel settings and widget popups no longer close when the pointer passes over another window.
explanation: These Plasma surfaces (side panel, panel configuration, applet popups) close as soon as they lose activation. With focus follows mouse KWin activated every window the pointer entered, so moving the pointer toward the activity switcher across a window closed it. Now, while the active window is a dock-type surface or an applet popup, KWin doesn't move focus on hover; clicking another window still activates it and dismisses the panel, and normal focus follows mouse between windows is unchanged.

commits.message:
window: don't move focus on hover away from a dock or applet popup

With focus follows mouse, crossing a window activated it, closing the
activity switcher, widget explorer or applet popups before the pointer
reached them; now hover keeps focus there and a click still closes them.

BUG: 336285

patches.diff:
From bb24d093922d4f5fdaef09c80b53d19d01175a71 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:27:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] window: don't move focus on hover away from a dock or applet
 popup

With focus follows mouse, crossing a window activated it, closing the
activity switcher, widget explorer or applet popups before the pointer
reached them; now hover keeps focus there and a click still closes them.

BUG: 336285
---
 src/window.cpp | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/window.cpp b/src/window.cpp
index 214e2d7671..ac5b1f5acb 100644
--- a/src/window.cpp
+++ b/src/window.cpp
@@ -2931,6 +2931,9 @@ void Window::pointerEnterEvent(const QPointF &globalPos)
     if (isDesktop() || isDock()) {
         return;
     }
+    if (const Window *active = workspace()->activeWindow(); active && (active->isDock() || active->isAppletPopup())) {
+        return;
+    }
     // for FocusFollowsMouse, change focus only if the mouse has actually been moved, not if the focus
     // change came because of window changes (e.g. closing a window) - #92290
     if (options->focusPolicy() != Options::FocusFollowsMouse
--

media.caption: Pointer moved slowly up-left onto Konsole: Konsole takes focus and the switcher closes
Same path with the fix: the switcher stays open and Konsole stays unfocused while the pointer rests on it

review.text: Handling Focus Follows Mouse hover suppression in KWin is the right direction for transient Wayland Plasma panels and popups, but this 3-line guard in Window::pointerEnterEvent() has two concrete flaws and thin verification. First, it runs after startAutoRaise(), so hovering across a window while a dock or applet popup is active still triggers auto-raise. Second, checking active->isDock() || active->isAppletPopup() unconditionally breaks Focus Follows Mouse when a pinned ('Keep Open') applet popup or a focused persistent panel/dock is active, and no KWin integration test or testing of applet popups, widget explorer, or panel configuration was done.
changes: Move the guard before the startAutoRaise() check in Window::pointerEnterEvent() (similar to workspace()->userActionsMenu()->isShown()) so crossed windows do not auto-raise while the dock or popup is active.

Narrow the exemption so it only applies to transient dismiss-on-deactivate surfaces rather than breaking Focus Follows Mouse for pinned ('Keep Open') applet popups or persistent panels/docks that hold keyboard focus.

Add a KWin integration autotest covering Focus Follows Mouse hover behavior while an applet popup/dock is active, and verify all claimed surfaces (applet popups including pinned ones, panel configuration, widget explorer, and auto-raise).

reviews.text: Right layer, as Martin suggested: these surfaces (side panel, panel config and panels are layer-shell 'dock' scope, applet popups are AppletPopup) close on deactivation, and KWin's hover focus was what deactivated them; skipping hover focus while a dock or applet popup is active is a minimal, readable policy change that still lets a click dismiss them and leaves normal focus-follows-mouse untouched. The after-2 screenshot clearly shows the switcher kept open with Konsole unfocused, and activation/pointer autotests pass. Nits for the MR: only the activity switcher was exercised (an applet popup and the panel config would round out the evidence), and pinned ('Keep Open') popups will now also hold focus until a click, which is worth mentioning; a small testPointerInput case would help KWin reviewers.
